opinions.feedback: Evidence is inconclusive for a blocker assessment as no cases are provided for R-176 and R-177.
Two requirements (R-176 and R-177) regarding theme image displays are not covered by any test cases, and the test cases for visual rendering/images cannot be fully verified without the image assets.
confirmed_blockers: R-176 and R-177 lack test cases to verify their display requirements.

analysis.analysis: Based on the validator feedback, requirements R-176 and R-177 depend on an external image reference that is not supplied, making the expected visual display unverifiable. Consequently, these visual verification scenarios cannot be reliably formulated or tested as structured test cases under the current constraints.
